results.reopen_during_close_same_process: a Database opened in the same process while the previous one was still closing on another thread failed with 'Checksum verification failed, the WAL file is corrupted.' Closing the writer and the database before releasing the owner lock fixed it (world-graph, 3 runs). Whether the WAL on disk was damaged, or the open read it mid-checkpoint, is not known.
